integrity.basis: Complete analytic Fourier factorization, exact sine products, moment Gram determinant identities, and Schur-complement inequality; finite checks are corroboration only.

scientific_limitations: Only unweighted undirected cycles, independent equal-strength two-site controls, affine Laplacian finite-time dynamics, and full-state determinants.
No continuous-time infinite-horizon, other graph, trace/condition-number, unequal-gain, or pseudodeterminant conclusion.
Published rank/controllability criteria are earlier work. General spectral Gramian factorizations are earlier work.
Historical priority not independently established; a particularly relevant 2017 cycle controllability paper was accessible only at abstract/bibliographic level.
title: Exact all-horizon two-actuator volume laws for cycle networks
